page_title: RBL 1-5 WOL | RB Leipzig v Wolfsburg 30/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+1' 1 - 5 Goal! Mattias Svanberg displays great vision and sends a pass to Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball from close range in the back of the net. The score is 1:5.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The current number of shots on goal is 4:7.
84' Here comes a substitution. Salih Ozcan is brought on as a substitute for Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg).
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kevin Behrens comes onto the pitch for Bence Dardai (Wolfsburg).
82' 1 - 4 Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Willi Orban (RB Leipzig), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 1:4.

82' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would probably have ended up inside the left side of the goal, but Kamil Grabara pulls off a superb reflex save and punches the ball onto the post.
80' The corner is swung in but RB Leipzig can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
80' RB Leipzig have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

79' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from RB Leipzig comes to nothing. RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
77' Christoph Baumgartner comes off the pitch to be replaced by Viggo Gebel (RB Leipzig).
77' The referee allows time for a substitution. Kevin Kampl will be replaced by Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig).
76' Ralph Hasenhuttl decides to make a substitution. Tiago Tomas will be replaced by Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg).
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) comes onto the pitch so that Patrick Wimmer can be given a rest.
75' The attendance is 40000.
70' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
69' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to make a change. Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) replaces Kilian Fischer.
69' It's time for a substitution. Andre Silva (RB Leipzig) comes on in place of Benjamin Sesko.
64' 0 - 4 GOAL - 0:4! The corner comes over and Konstantinos Koulierakis flicks on with his head to Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg), who makes no mistake and fires the ball into the back of the net.
64' Wolfsburg force a corner. They send men into the box.
62' The resulting set piece from RB Leipzig is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
61' RB Leipzig failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. It will be a corner kick for RB Leipzig.
59' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
58' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by RB Leipzig, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
57' The foul by Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Martin Petersen.
56' Wolfsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
55' Surely that's handball by one of the RB Leipzig players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
52' A yellow card for a tackle by Arthur Vermeeren (RB Leipzig). Martin Petersen doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
51' RB Leipzig take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
51' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. RB Leipzig will take a corner kick.
49' RB Leipzig take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
48' Martin Petersen has a clear sight and sees a foul from Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig).
47' Wolfsburg win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
46' Half-time substitution. Marco Rose decided to make a change. Amadou Haidara is replaced by Arthur Vermeeren (RB Leipzig).
46' The whistle blows and Martin Petersen starts the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Ball possession – 60:40.
43' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
38' The ball rebounds outside of the penalty area and falls to the feet of Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg), who directs his low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper is there to block the effort.

38' That didn't go as planned! Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the right side of the goal was too weak to get past Peter Gulacsi, who easily kept it out.
37' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) makes a strong challenge and Martin Petersen blows for a foul.
36' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 3:4.
32' Wolfsburg have been awarded a free kick from long distance, it won't be a direct shot.
30' Marco Rose is forced to make a change. Castello Lukeba is unable to continue due to injury, Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) comes on.
29' The game is interrupted now, Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

29' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) runs onto a pass and thumps the ball goalward from distance, but the keeper doesn't have to move as it goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
26' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Martin Petersen ignores the protests.
25' RB Leipzig have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
21' Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Martin Petersen blows for a foul. Wolfsburg have a free kick.
16' 0 - 3 Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom right corner. Magnificent finish!
14' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
10' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
5' 0 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Peter Gulacsi. He makes it 0:2.
4' 0 - 1 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) unleashes a shot straight into the roof of the net. Good team effort!
3' A pass by Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Wolfsburg will have the kick-off.
Martin Petersen will officiate today.
